titan_v1_execution_contract.goal: Finish Titan as an ordinary-user product rather than indefinitely improving architecture.
titan_v1_execution_contract.mandatory_scope_rule: Only P0/P1 findings that block the current V1 user scenario, safety/authority/data integrity, install/run, recovery, pilot, or release may create required work. P2/P3 are backlog.
titan_v1_execution_contract.finish_condition: P0=0, P1=0, bounded pilot passed, architecture/core/install/user-E2E/integration >=90 target, failure/recovery >=85, UX/operations >=85, then TITAN V1 — DONE.

user_capability_now: automatic existing [server] dependency installation when needed
safe local .env creation with random API key
fail-closed network and remote-data defaults for a new env
clear failure for unsupported Python, incomplete checkout, occupied port, dependency failure, early server exit, or health timeout
stage_2_installation_first_run.observation_boundary: Fresh ordinary-user end-to-end observation is still required later in Stage 9 and Stage 10; CI success and merge are not runtime observation.

maturity_estimates.note: Engineering estimates only; not formal admission, safety, release, or production metrics.

current_workstream.name: MODEL_PROVIDER_SETUP
current_workstream.problem: Provider execution exists, but the ordinary-user path from choosing a provider and entering an API key to obtaining a working model is not yet deterministic because remote-egress policy is fail-closed and onboarding surfaces do not consistently explain or satisfy the required policy conditions.
current_workstream.human_goal: An ordinary local user can intentionally connect a supported model, understand the remote-data boundary, test the connection, receive actionable errors, and keep fail-closed defaults when remote model use is not explicitly enabled.
must_preserve: remote model use remains explicit opt-in
no provider credential is silently promoted into Canon or authority
no runtime authority, Operator GO, remote Canon, or autonomous layer activation
next_actions: read exact current provider/console/egress setup paths
identify the smallest user-facing configuration gap
fix only P1-02 without weakening fail-closed policy
add focused tests for explicit opt-in, provider readiness and actionable failure states
run exact-head CI and merge-evidence gate before closure

p2_p3_backlog_not_mandatory_for_v1: full typed EvidenceReference to Evidence Admission architecture
